June 24, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Tower Bridge Advisors decreased its stake in Amgen Inc (AMGN) by 5.8% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tower Bridge Advisors sold 498 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.44% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,092 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.38 billion, down from 8,590 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tower Bridge Advisors who had been investing in Amgen Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $122.52 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.45% or $0.84 during the last trading session, reaching $185.15. About 2.44 million shares traded. Amgen Inc. (NASDAQ:AMGN) has risen 14.68% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.11% the S&P500.
